title: Cow holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M70 30 Q68 45 65 55' stroke='#E8E8E8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='20' rx='10' ry='12' fill='#FF4466'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='20' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#FF6688' opacity='0.5'/>
  <polygon points='68,31 72,31 70,35' fill='#CC2244'/>
  <!-- cow body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='65' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#F5F5F5'/>
  <!-- cow spots -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='60' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#4A4A6A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#4A4A6A'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='72' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#4A4A6A'/>
  <!-- cow legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='78' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#DDDDEE'/>
  <rect x='40' y='78' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#DDDDEE'/>
  <rect x='48' y='78' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#DDDDEE'/>
  <rect x='54' y='78' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#DDDDEE'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='27' y='88' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#4A4A6A'/>
  <rect x='39' y='88' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#4A4A6A'/>
  <rect x='47' y='88' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#4A4A6A'/>
  <rect x='53' y='88' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#4A4A6A'/>
  <!-- cow head -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='54' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#F5F5F5'/>
  <!-- cow ears -->
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='48' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#F5F5F5' transform='rotate(-20 49 48)'/>
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='48' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#F5F5F5' transform='rotate(20 71 48)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='58' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#FFB6C1'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='63' cy='57' r='1.2' fill='#CC6688'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='57' r='1.2' fill='#CC6688'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='51' r='2' fill='#2A2A4A'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='51' r='2' fill='#2A2A4A'/>
  <circle cx='56.5' cy='50.5' r='0.7' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='64.5' cy='50.5' r='0.7' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- horn nubs -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='44' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='44' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- arm holding balloon -->
  <path d='M65 62 Q68 58 70 55' stroke='#DDDDEE' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <path d='M30 63 Q25 60 24 58' stroke='#DDDDEE' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- udder -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='78' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FFB6C1'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M20 65 Q15 62 14 68' stroke='#DDDDEE' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='68' r='2.5' fill='#4A4A6A'/>
  <!-- grass ground -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='91' rx='26' ry='4' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='90' rx='24' ry='3' fill='#66BB6A'/>
</svg>
